_comment: Full comparison for the methods report: the five tests (in-air unchanged, Pinax, underwater Brown-Conrady, underwater Kannala-Brandt, Brown-Conrady + axial shift), the Pinax sea-water check and the two close-range-training (single-viewpoint) checks, all on the same held-out splits and the same detected corners; plus the WaterComparison tag test, residual quiver plots and parameter covariance. Run (from the project root): src/venv/bin/python src/experiments/compensation/run_comparison.py --config src/experiments/compensation/config_full.json && src/venv/bin/python src/experiments/compensation/make_report.py. reproduce.py compensation does both, after making the pipeline runs.

pipeline_runs._why: The Calibration.py runs this comparison reads, made by reproduce.py before it runs. Every pipeline setting is stated. They use the gray channel, as the runs these results were first made from did; the standard pipeline's channel is merge.

target._why: WaterComparison: ordinary AprilTag 36h11 tags (1-bit border), ids 6-11 in 3 rows x 2 columns, outer black square printed at 145 mm (G. Jones). One stereo pair per distance label (cm) in pairs.csv: 50, 100, 150, 200, 250.

detection._why: The calibration's own preset finds the tags, on CLAHE-enhanced gray, with aruco's CORNER_REFINE_CONTOUR. The pipeline's cornerSubPix (window 15% of the tag side, tuned for the board's X-junctions) has no junction to lock onto on these tags: on 12 Oct it moved corners up to 26 px and gave edges of 195-274 mm, while CLAHE + CONTOUR measured 145.4 mm mean on 23 tags at every label. Set corner_refinement to 'subpix' to reproduce the pipeline's refinement, or 'none' for the raw quads.

covariance._why: Intrinsic covariance sigma^2 (J^T J)^-1 with the board poses eliminated (calibmethods/covariance.py), for every technique fitted in water; the in-air techniques' intrinsics come from this in-air run, so its covariance is computed on its own frames.
